title: Weekly Recap: Gemma 4 & Claude 5 Rollouts
author: Modelverse Curators
excerpt: The race is heating up. Google DeepMind shipped the Gemma 4 (31B Dense) open-weights model, while Anthropic teased API previews for Claude 5 Sonnet. We break down the release schedules.
body:
The AI ecosystem continues to move at a relentless pace. This week saw two major updates from Google DeepMind and Anthropic.

### Gemma 4 (31B Dense)
Google DeepMind shocked the open-weights community by dropping **Gemma 4**, a 31-billion parameter dense model. Initial benchmarks show strong parity with closed frontier models in coding proficiency and math solving. It features:
- 128k context window
- Native tool-calling capabilities
- Permissive commercial license terms

### Claude 5 Sonnet Previews
Anthropic quietely updated its API documentation, adding references to an upcoming **Claude 5 Sonnet** release. Select enterprise accounts have reportedly been granted early access to developer sandboxes. We expect the public rollout to showcase major advances in low-latency agentic loops and vision-based browser control.

Stay tuned as we continue to track and verify these releases.
